  • Du hast eine eigene Wachstums- und Strategie-Linie für deinen Bereich vorgelegt.

Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Dein Bereich wächst messbar — über Akquise, Cross-Sell und, wo relevant, integrierte Mandatsstämme.

  • Du hast deine Führungslinie weiterentwickelt und auf Bereichs-Ebene eingestellt.

  • Deine Bereichsstrategie ist in der Unternehmensstrategie sichtbar verankert.

Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Dein Bereich trägt einen erkennbaren, eigenständigen Beitrag zum Geschäftsergebnis der Gruppe.

  • Du hast die fachlichen Standards deines Bereichs gesetzt und nach außen Reputation aufgebaut.

  • Du bist als Bereichs-Owner etabliert und auf dem Principal-/VP-Pfad entlang unseres Career Frameworks.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Über die Director-Stufe öffnet sich der Principal-/VP-Pfad — die unternehmerische Owner-Verantwortung für eine ganze strategische Säule mit Mitverantwortung für die Unternehmensstrategie. Director Tax ist eine Rolle mit echtem Bereichs-Eigentum: Über die Cash-Vergütung hinaus ist vorgesehen, dass du unternehmerisch am Mehrwert partizipierst, den du mit deinem Bereich schaffst.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du hast das Steuerberater-Examen bestanden und danach auf geführt — eine Sub-Organisation, mehrere Teams oder einen Standort.

  • Du hast einen Bereich nicht nur geführt, sondern wachsen lassen — mit nachweisbarem Beitrag zu Output und Ergebnis.

  • Du hast Führungskräfte geführt, fachliche Standards gesetzt und Personalverantwortung in der Tiefe getragen.

  • Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, aber die Substanz mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Big4-Director oder Partner-Anwärter mit Mittelstands-Wellenlänge; Kanzlei-Führungskraft am Sprung zur eigenen Bereichs-Owner-Rolle. Die ausgewiesene Range kalibriert auf das Primärprofil — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du beherrschst die Mechanik eines Tax-Geschäfts — Mandatsführung, Leverage, Qualität und Ergebnis — und steuerst sie über mehrere Teams hinweg.

  • Du denkst strategisch und führst zugleich operativ kompetent; du verlierst die Mandatsrealität nicht aus dem Blick.

  • Du arbeitest mit AI als selbstverständlichem Hebel und treibst die Automatisierung deines Bereichs, statt sie abzuwarten.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du denkst und handelst wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen — der Bereich ist dein Bereich, sein Wachstum deine Verantwortung.

  • Du begegnest mittelständischen Inhabern mit echtem Respekt und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du und deine Linie abliefern, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

  • Vogel ist hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Keine Partnergesellschaft mit konkurrierenden Eigeninteressen. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit One-Firm-Logik — eine Marke, eine Kultur, eine Hiring-Bar. Kein Management-by-Committee.

  • Kein repräsentativer Titel ohne echte Owner-Verantwortung. Du trägst Strategie, Output und Ergebnis deines Bereichs — nicht ein Schild an der Tür.

  • Kein Führen aus der Distanz. Du bleibst nah an den wichtigsten Mandaten und an deiner Linie; reine Steuerung von oben gibt es bei uns nicht.

  • Kein Erbhof-Modell. Dein Auftrag ist Wachstum, nicht Verwaltung des Bestands.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen.

3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus?

Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.

Du absolvierst gerade ein Studium in Marketing, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder Psychologie, Kommunikations- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich und möchtest uns unterstützen. Traumhaft wären erste praktische Erfahrungen in Form von Praktika. Ist aber kein Muss. Was viel wichtiger ist: Du hast Lust. Auf Menschen, Marken, Zielgruppen, Zeitgeschehen und vor allem Daten. Auch wichtig: Du bist klar im Denken, in der Analyse auf den Punkt. Du weißt, wie du komplexe Themen auf wenig Platz pointiert zusammenfasst. Jetzt weißt du, wofür deine Statistik-Vorlesungen gut waren. Damit leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag, um spannende Insights zu finden, auf deren Basis punktgenaue Creative Briefs oder Analysen erstellt werden können. Bei aller Liebe zur Teamarbeit kannst du auch eigenständig arbeiten und die dir übertragenen Aufgaben gewissenhaft und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen. Wen wir suchen. Eine*n Werkstudent*in für den Bereich Strategy / Research. In Berlin. Ab sofort, gerne bald. Für eine Zusammenarbeit von mindestens 18 Monaten. Was wir bieten. Wir sind ein kleines schlagkräftiges Kernteam bestehend aus Beratung, Kreation, Strategie und Digital Services. Aus diesen Disziplinen bilden wir interdisziplinäre Projektteams, die wir bei Bedarf durch unser ausgewähltes Netzwerk an Expert*innen in den Bereichen Daten und Psychographie, Mediastrategie und -buchungen und Produktion erweitern. Durch diese kurzen Wege und flexiblen Prozesse sind wir agil und können schnell, proaktiv und eng mit unseren Kund*innen zusammenarbeiten. Wir leben eine offene und lebendige Agenturkultur, in der dein individueller Beitrag zählt, um zusammen mit Empathie und Spaß zu den wirklich guten Lösungen und Ergebnissen zu kommen. Bei uns darfst du genauso sein, wie du bist. Wenn du nach deinem Studium bleiben willst, wäre das ein Win-Win für beide Seiten. Was, wenn's passt? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung von qualifizierten Menschen. Jeder geschlechtlichen und sexuellen Identität. Jeglicher Religionszugehörigkeit. Jeden Alters. Von Bewerbenden mit Migrationshintergrund, People of Colour und/oder Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wiedereinsteiger*innen. Eltern. Quereinsteiger*innen. Alle sind bei uns gleichermaßen willkommen. Schick uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen und lass uns wissen, wer du bist. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du deine Unterlagen auch anonymisiert als Blind-Bewerbung einreichen – wir stellen einen fairen und transparenten Auswahlprozess sicher. Wir freuen uns auf dich. Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst. Deine Ansprechpartnerin. Anette Lezak. title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
description: Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht. Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt. Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt. Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern. Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess. Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen. Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf. Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall. Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe. Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten. Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst. Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen. Große Stückzahlen, große Wirkung: Wir entwickeln bewusst wenige Modelle mit hohem Volumen. Technische Verbesserungen, die du entwickelst, wirken sich direkt auf hunderttausende Produkte aus. Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen. Du stellst dein eigenes Team zusammen: Du entscheidest mit, welche Kompetenzen wir wann intern aufbauen und entwickelst daraus eine leistungsstarke Footwear-Development-Organisation. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Design und Sourcing: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und keine langen Konzernschleifen zwischen Entwicklung, Design und Produktion. Nähe zu den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit den Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und kannst technische Produktentscheidungen direkt auf höchster Ebene beeinflussen. Internationales Produktionsumfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktions-, Material- und Tooling-Partnern in Asien zusammen und bist dort, wo die Produkte tatsächlich entstehen. Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt schneller Kompromisse: Bei Pammys ist Passform kein Detail. Du bekommst den Raum, Standards aufzubauen, mit denen unsere Produkte technisch und qualitativ langfristig besser werden. Wachstum mit Verantwortung: Mit neuen Modellen, Kategorien und höheren Volumen wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich und damit die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Produktfunktion bei Pammys langfristig zu prägen. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find. The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app. What you'll work on Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain  Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision. Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market. Our humble expectations We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them. You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience. You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it. You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight. You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick. You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself. You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype. You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets. description: Your mission Full technical ownership of Rocket — reporting directly to the founders, with no layer in between In this role you own engineering at MICE DESK — fully. There is no CTO layer above you: architecture, technology, delivery, and team are yours, and you report directly to the founders. This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead the engineering team including our AI/Data function, own the interface to Product, and are accountable for everything that ships. Engineering, end-to-end. Architecture, system design, delivery against the roadmap, reliability, technical debt. Backend, frontend, DevOps, QA, and the AI/Data team all roll up to you. You set lightweight processes that let a small team ship fast without breaking things. An AI-enabled engineering pipeline. We don't just build AI products — we build with AI. You make the engineering organization itself AI-native: agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted review and testing, automation of everything repetitive. A small team should ship like one three times its size — making that true is your job. AI as a core system capability. You architect the integration of LLMs and agentic workflows into production systems: deterministic logic combined with AI-generated outputs, with real validation, fallbacks, and reliability strategies. Hotel operations run on our platform — non-determinism is no excuse for unreliability. The team. Hire, mentor, scale. You inherit a strong small team and grow it into a high-performance engineering organization with a culture of ownership and speed. Our distributed hiring strategy across multiple locations is yours as well. Product and business alignment. You work directly with the founders and Product. You challenge requirements, simplify complexity, and connect engineering work to outcomes: revenue, automation, customer impact. As we enter the US market, engineering has to keep pace with enterprise-scale customers on two continents. What success looks like: 6 months: Delivery is predictable, the AI-enabled dev pipeline is running, and the team has grown with A-players you hired. 12 months: The platform scales with US enterprise customers, core systems are reliable and observable, and engineering is a competitive advantage — not a bottleneck. Honestly: This is full accountability with no net above it. No CTO layer to make or catch decisions — the architecture, the team, and everything that ships are yours. If you want a role where someone above you sets direction, this isn't it. If you want exactly that ownership, it is. Your profile 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in an engineering leadership role at high-growth product companies. Strong hands-on backend or full-stack background — you can still go deep. Proven experience scaling engineering teams at growing startups. Strong architecture expertise: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, cloud. LLM / agentic AI systems in production — and genuine conviction that engineering itself should be AI-assisted. Product mindset: you connect technical decisions to business outcomes. About the team

Our team leads the independent validation and verification of complex software systems, bridging the gap between rigorous architectural requirements and deployed capabilities. We operate at the critical intersection of software development and system safety, ensuring every release meets the highest performance and reliability standards. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in sofware & hardware, and flight operations to maintain technical integrity in a fast-paced environment.


Your mission

As the Software IVV Lead, you will act as the independent software testing and verification authority, ensuring that the standards defined by our architecture are measurably adhered to, rigorously tested, and successfully audited. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of software validation and verification, serving as the ultimate quality gatekeeper for our software release candidates before they reach hardware integration and testing in the field.


Responsibilities

  • Define the Test Strategy: Establish and enforce the overarching software testing frameworks and QA processes (based on ISTQB) across all software capability teams.

  • Manage Test Infrastructure & Tooling: Oversee the setup and maintenance of software test environments and test data, ensure the qualification of testing tools, and lead the generation of audit-proof, revision-safe test evidence.

  • Oversee V&V Execution: Supervise the validation and verification phases of the V-Model, ensuring rigorous unit, integration, and sub-system-level testing are completed before handing over to the Hardware integration and Flight Testing teams.

  • Ensure Requirements Traceability: Deliver transparency in bidirectional traceability between Software Requirements, architectural design, implementation, and testing. Define and monitor the traceability processes in close collaboration with Software Configuration Management (SCM), ensuring operational compliance.

  • Govern Defect & Deviation Management: Establish and oversee the interfaces and processes for defect, deviation, and problem management, ensuring all findings from testing are systematically tracked, evaluated, and resolved.

  • Interface with Configuration Management: Verify compliance with defined SCM processes, auditing baselines, versions, reproducible builds, Software Configuration Indexes, and Release Packages to ensure they meet quality standards.

  • Familiarity with preparing for and leading external regulatory audits and internal quality assessments.

description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. About the team As a Datalink Integration & Test Engineer , you will play a key role in bringing together complex software systems that power our next generation of autonomous platforms. Your mission Your mission is to take established, proven MANET (mobile ad-hoc network) radio systems and make them work — reliably, repeatably, and under real-world constraints — inside our unmanned platforms. In this role you focus on the datalinks for our close- and short-range loitering effector and ISR systems, where the link has to stay solid through fast-moving, time-critical mission profiles in contested airspace. You own the path from "commercial radio in a box" to "integrated, tested, mission-ready datalink." This is a hands-on integration and test role at the boundary of RF hardware, networking, and platform architecture. You own two connections that have to hold up when it counts: the command-and-control link between UAV and ground control station (GCS), and the mesh that lets multiple effectors operate as a coordinated swarm. You aren't just wiring in a radio; you are certifying that command and control survives contact with the real world, and giving the engineering team the hard data to trust it. Responsibilities Integration Integrate established MANET / mesh radio systems (e.g., Silvus StreamCaster, Persistent Systems Wave Relay, Rajant, Radionor) into STARK's platform architecture across the mechanical, power, RF, and network/software interfaces. Define and implement the integration approach for each datalink — antenna placement, RF front-end, IP networking, and interfacing with the autopilot and payload stack. Integrate and configure the UAV-to-GCS command-and-control link, ensuring reliable telemetry, control, and video across the full mission profile through to the terminal phase. Set up and tune multi-node mesh topologies that enable UAV-to-UAV connectivity and coordinated swarm operation of multiple effectors, including relay and self-healing behaviour. Work closely with hardware, autopilot, and systems engineering to ensure the communication subsystem is correctly matched to the platform and its constraints. Test & Validation Design and execute structured test campaigns — bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and field trials — to validate datalink behaviour. Characterise link performance across throughput, latency, range, mesh routing behaviour, and resilience under interference and degraded conditions. Validate swarm behaviour at the network level — multi-node mesh scaling, UAV-to-UAV and UAV-to-GCS connectivity, relay hops, and graceful degradation as nodes join, move, or drop out. Build up repeatable test procedures and instrumentation, and produce clear, traceable documentation of setups, methods, and results. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Translate field and test findings into concrete integration and configuration improvements. Support trade-offs and selection decisions between candidate datalink systems with measured, defensible data. Contribute to the evolution of STARK's communication integration standards and test methodology. Qualifications Experience & Certifications Professional background in Electronics / Communications Engineering or a comparable technical field. Hands-on experience integrating MANET / mesh radio or tactical datalink systems into a larger platform or system. Technical Background Solid grounding in RF fundamentals and antenna/propagation basics. Strong understanding of IP networking, routing, and the OSI model as it applies to mesh and point-to-point links. Comfortable working in Linux networking environments and debugging at the hardware/software boundary. Structured, disciplined approach to test design, execution, and documentation. Profile Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Analytical, thorough, and outcome-oriented — you want the integration to be clean and the results to hold up, not just to work once. Nice to have Hands-on experience with specific MANET vendor ecosystems and their management/config tooling. Knowledge of tactical datalink bands, waveforms, FHSS, and encryption.   • Define and implement the integration approach for each datalink — antenna placement, RF front-end, IP networking, and interfacing with the autopilot and payload stack.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Developer Experience
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Backend Engineer in the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/developer-experience/"><strong>Developer Experience</strong></a> group, you’ll work cross-functionally to help us identify and improve the engineering experience across GitLab’s internal engineering teams. We’re at a pivotal time in transforming our testing approach and development experience to enable engineers to deliver high-quality code efficiently and with confidence.&nbsp;</p> <p><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/developer-experience/test-governance/">Developer Experience</a> currently has six, globally distributed teams of Backend Engineers and Software Engineers in Test. This role will work across the entire group to help us identify and remove the biggest points of friction that affect development at GitLab. Expect to split your time between hands-on coding in Ruby and Go, designing scalable solutions and helping every team deliver.&nbsp; You’ll be instrumental in shaping our engineering culture across GitLab.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a highly visible role with strong company-wide support. You’ll be instrumental in shifting our culture and practices toward a cohesive Developer Experience Platform strategy—backed by buy-in and appetite for change.</p> <h3><strong>Some examples of our projects</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Identifying and removing the source of flakiness in our tests pipelines</li> <li>Introducing comprehensive test coverage reporting to guide our decisions about what and when to test</li> <li>Standardizing logging libraries and documentation to make it easy for all features and components to provide consistent logs</li> <li>Providing stable, configurable development environments&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Technical Excellence Across Teams</strong>: Provide hands-on engineering contributions and technical leadership across six Developer Experience teams, jumping in to unblock critical work or accelerate high-impact initiatives</li> <li><strong>Champion Engineering Needs</strong>: Partner with engineering teams across GitLab to identify pain points, gather feedback, and translate day-to-day frustrations into actionable improvements for the Developer Experience roadmap</li> <li><strong>Transform Testing at Scale</strong>: Help us modernize our testing to support GitLab's growth—ensuring engineers have fast, reliable tools that catch issues early without slowing them down</li> <li><strong>Optimize CI/CD Pipelines</strong>: Reduce merge and CI friction by building workflows that deliver fast, actionable feedback—helping engineers iterate confidently and ship faster</li> <li><strong>Break Down Systemic Bottlenecks</strong>: Collaborate with Platform, Product, and Infrastructure teams to identify and eliminate the architectural and process friction that slows down development</li> <li><strong>Shape Engineering Culture</strong>: Foster a culture of continuous learning, inclusion, and improvement—where great developer experience is a shared value across the organization</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Deep experience with developer tooling, DevEx strategies, and testing frameworks at scale</li> <li>Experience leading platform or transformation initiatives across multiple teams</li> <li>Proven ability to influence without authority and collaborate across functions</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in a remote-first environment</li> <li>A product mindset with a passion for empowering developers</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$131,600</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$282,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description: <p><strong>Position Overview:&nbsp;</strong></p> <div>We are excited to introduce a newly created Senior HR Business Partner role, partnering directly with the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to drive organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and strategic workforce planning across the business.&nbsp;Central to the role is holding senior leaders accountable for their own growth as leaders: coaching them with the same rigor they are expected to apply to their teams, so that as leaders level up, their team’s level up alongside them. You will help drive effective people practices by balancing business priorities with employee experience and will play a key role in evolving Diligent’s HR operating model toward more strategic, AI-enabled ways of working. The ideal candidate is collaborative, business-minded, and solutions-oriented, with strong judgment, communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders – while being direct enough to hold them to account.</div> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a senior strategic HR partner to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) for an assigned business unit or regional pod, leading org design, talent planning, succession planning, and coaching.</li> <li>Develop the people strategy for the business unit or function you support, in partnership with senior leadership, translating business strategy and objectives into a people plan that delivers maximum impact.</li> <li>Lead strategic workforce planning for the business unit — including how work is organised across people and AI agents — and navigating the balance between building AI capability and developing the human skills needed for the future in an AI-first organisation.</li> <li>Partner with the HR Director on implementation and functional roll-out of the broader people strategy.</li> <li>Lead the business unit’s talent and performance cycles, including goal-setting/OKR cadence, SLT-level calibrations, compensation review for the SLT-and-below population, and 9-box grid review.</li> <li>Drive turning workforce, engagement, and performance data into insight that drives real business impact, using OHI, pulse, and talent analytics to inform decisions rather than just report on them.</li> <li>Coach SLT members and hold them accountable for their own growth and their teams’ development, ensuring leaders level up their people while delivering their OKRs.</li> <li>Hold senior leaders accountable for role-modelling the standards expected of their teams, giving direct feedback when leadership behaviour is holding a team back, and following up to confirm it changes.</li> <li>Own escalated and senior-level employee relations investigations, acting as the escalation point for higher-risk cases before they reach the HR Director.</li> <li>Act as practice lead for cyclical HR activities within the business unit, collaborating with Business Partners and HR Assistants to ensure consistent, in-time zone support across the pod.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience/Skills&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience serving as a senior HR partner to business leaders, including direct partnership with a Senior Leadership Team (SLT) or equivalent within a regional or business-unit-aligned HRBP model.</li> <li>Strong org design, strategic workforce planning, and succession planning expertise, with the ability to apply it in service of an evolving, regionally structured HR operating model.</li> <li>Experience leading escalated or complex employee relations investigations and acting as an escalation point above front-line HR Business Partners.</li> <li>Proven track record coaching senior leaders and holding them accountable for their own development and their teams’ growth – comfortable giving direct, challenging feedback that helps leaders and their people level up together.</li> <li>Familiarity with HRIS and workflow systems, and openness to AI-enabled ways of working as repetitive HR operations move to automation and shared services.</li> <li>Strong communication, stakeholder management, judgment, and problem-solving skills, with comfort operating in a newly introduced role where boundaries with adjacent HRBP tiers are still being defined.</li> </ul> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Calibri; font-size: 11.0pt; color: #979797;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-SM1</span></p> <p lang="en-AU" style="margin: 0in; font-family: Calibri; font-size: 11.0pt; color: #979797;"><span Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Why this job posting

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you!

Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together.

What it's like to work here

A few things that are true about working here:

We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months.

We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone.

We hold a high bar. Average loses. Even good often does. We're here to do the best work of our careers, and we back each other to get there, low ego, high trust.

It's not an easy game. We're in AI, the most competitive space in the world, and nobody is going to give us this market. We have to take it.

As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.</p> <p>Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. We are at the forefront of reimagining how government engages with its citizens.</p> <p>This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.</p> <p>As Senior Associate, Social the successful candidate will rapidly develop their knowledge of paid advertising across all the key social channels, from activation through to reporting. They will also learn how to work as part of a team that plan &amp; deliver award-winning work in a busy agency environment that has training + development at its core.&nbsp;</p> <p>Key Responsibilities:&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of a busy Paid Social team the role is varied with several areas of focus. Account Executives will be given all the necessary training to help develop the skills required to fulfil their responsibilities. These include:&nbsp;</p> <p>Campaign Management&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>End-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms.</li> <li>Undertaking regular quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.</li> <li>Monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure activity delivers as expected. Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns in order to improve performance as necessary.</li> <li>Working to produce detailed &amp; accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel.</li> <li>Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients.</li> <li>Assisting with more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and on standalone projects.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Client &amp; Partner Management&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Working closely with your line-manager &amp; the wider team (including the Global Hub team) to support the delivery of high-quality work for clients. &nbsp;</li> <li>Working with partners and attending regular platform training sessions to further develop your paid social skillset.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Operational Excellence&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Responsible for managing your workload and for communicating clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person.</li> <li>Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community.</li> <li>Responsible for following the mandatory agency finance processes. Working with line-manager and to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>The Account Executive position is aimed at someone passionate about starting a career in digital marketing and paid social. We are looking for a candidate with the following attributes:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Display an eagerness to learn. You should be diligent and attentive to detail, able to listen, learn new skills, and put these into practice quickly. &nbsp;</li> <li>Able to display in interest in how digital advertising/marketing works (especially on social media channels) and a have desire to further your knowledge in this area.</li> <li>Computer literate with a good base of skills across the Microsoft Office suite of programmes (including Excel). &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</li> <li>Being part of a busy agency environment we regularly work with large amounts of data so a confidence with numbers is also a must. &nbsp;</li> <li>Teamwork is key to this role and we are looking for someone who is collaborative, friendly, and with a can-do attitude. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering </strong>at Parloa, you’ll be on the front lines of enterprise AI adoption — leading a high-impact team of FDEs that delivers our most strategic enterprise deployments. Your mission is to ensure our consistent deployment excellence: predictable delivery, strong engineering quality, and fast unblocking in complex enterprise environments — while staying technically credible yourself.</p> <p>FDEs are our in-field engineers. They build what doesn’t exist yet, adapt architecture to enterprise realities, and engineer integrations across systems and APIs to make deployments successful. (architecture, security, platform) to deliver outcomes and build long-term technical trust.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Tech Stack:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Typescript, NodeJS, OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Full-Stack System Execution : Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover. Cross-Functional Alignment : Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs. Site Infrastructure Readiness : Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment. Acceptance Testing & Governance : Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols. Service & Operational Handoff : Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime. Process Standardisation : Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. Supply Chain Management : Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Experience - Essentials Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times. Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints. Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams. Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find. The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app. What you'll work on Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain  Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision. Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market. Our humble expectations We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them. You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience. You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it. You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight. You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick. You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June. You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself. You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype. You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets. You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! This leader will connect direct, reseller, and outsourced channels; turn market priorities into execution; and shape a repeatable growth model that protects advertiser outcomes and user trust. This role reports directly to the VP of Global Ads Solutions and will be a key member of their leadership team. You will set the scaled sales strategy across direct, reseller, and business-process-outsourcing (BPO) channels; identify priority markets; and translate that strategy into sequenced, measurable in-market execution. This is a highly strategic and operational leadership role responsible for scaled sales revenue growth and channel performance. You will design the reseller model, select priority vendors and markets, lead RFPs and contracting, and manage partners against clear commercial and customer-quality standards. You will also work closely with outsourced vendors in the BPO channel and test a focused mid-market sales team as a potential growth engine. The ideal candidate combines scaled go-to-market strategy, channel leadership, vendor-management discipline, experimentation, and operational rigor. Establish scalable processes, playbooks, controls, and best practices that support responsible growth across markets, channels, and customer segments. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 15+ years of experience in digital advertising, media, technology, or related commercial leadership roles. Have 10+ years of experience leading high-performing scaled sales, account management, customer success, or revenue teams. Are experienced in building new products from the ground up, and comfortable in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. Are passionate and energized by the new possibilities of AI being applied to marketing, and have strong desire to play a role in shaping that future. Have a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and scaling performance-advertising businesses across multiple channels and markets. Have deep experience with reseller and outsourced sales operations, including vendor selection, RFPs, contracting, onboarding, enablement, governance, and performance management. Are an exceptional people leader who enjoys recruiting, coaching, developing, and inspiring teams to achieve ambitious goals. Can build strong relationships with reseller executives, BPO leaders, advertisers, and senior internal decision-makers. Can turn strategy into prioritized market actions, explicit owners, measurable milestones, and a disciplined operating cadence. description: About Numan    Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.   Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.   To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:    • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply.   Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The Role We build and operate a regulated digital health platform. Patients trust us with clinical data, identity documents and payment details, and our clinicians trust our systems to be correct. That makes application security a patient safety concern, not just a compliance one. We are shipping quickly, adopting AI and agentic systems across clinical operations and patient-facing products, and running a lean security function that scales through engineering leverage rather than headcount. We need a senior engineer who can go deep on design and code, then bring the rest of the business along with them. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with genuine influence over how the platform is built. The Team You will work within the Cyber Security function, collaborating directly with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Legal, and the executive team. Security at Numan is not a gatekeeping function — it scales through influence, credibility, and being useful early. You'll be: Running threat modelling sessions with product and engineering teams on new features and architectural changes — STRIDE-based, with clinical safety, abuse, and business-logic threats kept in mind alongside the technical ones. Owning and evolving our Secure by Design process: self-evaluation screening, secure design review, and the threat modelling pathway, including our use of automated tooling against technical artefacts. Turning threat models into tracked, prioritised controls that engineering teams actually implement. Pushing design decisions upstream so the cheap fix is designed in rather than the expensive one retrofitted. Assessing and securing AI systems in production: LLM-backed features, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, tool-calling integrations, and the MCP and API surfaces that connect them. Building practical threat models and controls for agent-specific failure modes — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, data exfiltration through context, unsafe autonomy, and supply chain risk in model and plugin ecosystems. Performing automated application and API penetration testing against our own products — web, mobile backends, cloud-native services on GCP, internal tooling, and AI features. Leading penetration engagements with third parties and working on the fix with engineering. Chaining findings into realistic attack paths and demonstrating impact, rather than delivering a list of scanner output. Embedding security into our pipelines: SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container and dependency hygiene — tuned so signal beats noise and engineers trust the gates. Working with platform and engineering to raise baseline standards: authentication and authorisation patterns, secrets management, tenancy isolation, and logging and detection coverage. Actively participating in the security community — OWASP chapters or projects, local meetups, CTFs, research groups — and publishing research, write-ups, or blog posts under your own name. We're looking for someone who: Brings substantial hands-on application security experience in a product engineering environment, at senior level. Has demonstrable threat modelling practice — not just familiarity with the theory. Has practical offensive skills against modern web and API stacks, with an appropriate certification or equivalent demonstrable experience (OSCP, OSWE, CREST, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or similar). Is comfortable reading and reasoning about code in at least one language used in production systems, and can review a pull request meaningfully. Has working knowledge of cloud-native architecture and its security model — ideally GCP, but AWS or Azure experience transfers. Has experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD, and the scars to know what makes engineers ignore it. Has a track record of shipping security improvements through other teams. Has experience securing AI or agentic systems in production. Has hands-on experience securing Kubernetes environments and managing cloud security posture using CNAPP and CSPM solutions, with a primary focus on GCP but AWS and Azure experience is translatable. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>At Too Good To Go, we dream of a planet with no food waste.</strong></span></p> <p>Did you know that more than 40% of all food produced gets thrown away? This unnecessary food waste — and the resources needed to produce and transport it — accounts for 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions.</p> <p>Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why This Role</strong></span></p> <p>Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.</p> <p>We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.</p> <p>You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.</p> <p>The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.</p> <p>There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.</p> <p>In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need. From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.</p> <p>Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.</p> <p>Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.</p> <p>You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The Team</strong></span></p> <p>You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.</p> <p>This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.</p> <p>The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Build the pricing infrastructure for Key Account deals, giving commercial teams the tools and flexibility to structure partnerships well while keeping pricing logic sound and scalable.</li> <li>Design and develop a smart pricing algorithm — moving from static, rules-based pricing toward a dynamic model informed by supply, demand, and partner-specific economics.</li> <li>Investigate consumer-facing service fees: how they're set, how they perform, and how they should evolve to balance consumer value with business sustainability.</li> <li>Take a holistic view of pricing across TGTG, Partners, and Consumers — optimising for meals saved and for growing the pie for all three, rather than trading one off against another.</li> <li>Research and apply best practices and patterns from marketplace pricing more broadly, adapting proven approaches to our specific dynamics rather than reinventing from scratch.</li> <li>Own the roadmap and OKRs for the Pricing team within its agreed mandate, sequencing the work so that early wins on Key Accounts build toward the algorithm and fee strategy.</li> <li>Work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing decisions are right wherever they show up, not just within your own roadmap.</li> <li>Be the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting strategy, models, and results to the Global Management Team.</li> <li>Anticipate the pricing complexity and opportunity of TGTG's expansion into non-food, non-perishable categories, and
