description: <h3>About Dwelly</h3> <p>Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.<br><br>We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.</p> <h3>Position Summary</h3> <p>We are seeking a highly talented and hands-on Product Designer to help shape the experience across the full set of Dwelly products (Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, CRM) and the internal back-office tools that power them. This role involves deeply understanding our user personas (Tenant, Landlord, Maintenance Contractor, Dwelly Agent) and designing for both the customer-facing portals and the operational tools our agents use every day.</p> <p>Given the early stage of the business, our current products are hyper-functional but quite basic — an "MVP" that prioritises getting the job done across all domains. You'll work closely with product and engineering to take these to the next level: bringing clarity, usability, and craft to data-dense, workflow-heavy internal tools, and building genuinely good experiences for tenants and landlords. You'll also help establish the basic building blocks of design at Dwelly — a shared design system, patterns, and a lightweight design process — from the ground up.</p> <p>Our current development team is a team of 5, a few analysts, and one product designer. You'll join a small, fast-moving product team and have an outsized impact on how the whole product looks, feels, and works.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <p><strong>1. </strong><strong>User Research &amp; Insights</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with product to understand user pain points across all personas — tenants, landlords, maintenance contractors, and internal agents.</li> <li>Turn qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions.</li> <li>Act as an advocate for usability and the end user within the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. End-to-End Product Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UIs for both customer-facing products (tenant and landlord portals) and internal back-office tools.</li> <li>Design for data-dense, workflow-heavy operational products where clarity and efficiency matter more than decoration.</li> <li>Own the design process from concept and prototyping through to polished, build-ready specs, and iterate after launch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Design Across the Product Suite</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring consistency and quality across Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, and the communications/portal layer.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineers and product managers to translate requirements into shippable design, balancing craft with speed and technical feasibility.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Design System &amp; Process Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain a shared design system, component library, and reusable patterns.</li> <li>Introduce lightweight design workflows, documentation, and review/handoff practices suited to an early-stage team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>&nbsp;Qualifications &amp; Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio spanning both complex/operational tools and consumer-facing products. Comfortable in early-stage, low-structure environments as well as more structured, product-led settings.</li> <li><strong>Skills:</strong> Strong interaction and visual design skills; systems thinking; exceptional attention to detail; able to design for complexity and make it feel simple. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across product and engineering.</li> <li>In step with recent technology advancements: <strong>can prototype and ship designs quickly and independently with the help of AI.</strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing operational, back-office, or B2B tools where efficiency and workflow are central — ideally in tech-enabled or operational businesses.</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to a design system from scratch.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership, a "get things done" attitude, and excellent attention to detail.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.</li> </ul> <h3>What is it like being a Dwell-er?</h3> <p>Feel free to check out <a href="https://docsend.com/view/7v8gwrjaky7mn895">Dwelly Core Principles</a>. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.</p> <p>What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for &gt;30% of households (&gt;5M in the UK, and &gt;100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.</p> <p>This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.</p> <ul> <li>Customer obsession rather than competitive focus</li> <li>Passion for invention</li> <li>Operational excellence</li> <li>Long-term thinking</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-start="556" data-end="829">By applying for this position, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data for recruitment purposes for up to 365 days, in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable data protection laws.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.   As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.   We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities. What You'll Do Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys. Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform. Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders. Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities. Who You Are You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus. You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale. You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc. You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements. You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives. You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production. You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission. Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines. Where You'll Be This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Assistant Merchandiser at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Reporting into the department Merchandising Manager, you will be instrumental in assisting in the management of intake and the stock profile of your department to support driving KPI's. You will be focused on reacting to trade to drive profit, improving efficiencies and providing reporting and analysis whilst mentoring junior members of the team.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As&nbsp;</span><strong><em><span data-contrast="auto">Senior Assistant Merchandiser</span></em></strong><span data-contrast="auto">, you’ll be responsible for: </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>WSSI management to include risk mitigation and maximise opportunities.</li> <li>Special project management in conjunction with Merchandising Manager.</li> <li>Recommends re buys as necessary, reviewing under and overstocks with suggested actions to maintain optimum stock health.</li> <li>Analyses best and worst sellers making informed recommendations for action.
